name: agent-run-lanes
title: Agent Run Lanes
description: A replay of a multi-agent run with one swim lane per agent, task bars that fill as a playhead sweeps the time axis and curved handoff links that draw in when work passes between agents. Drag the track or use the arrow keys to scrub, and a status line narrates the latest event.
author: Hyperblur <hello@hyperblur.dev>
